_note: Standing faculty decisions, machine-readable. A decision that governs code carries `governs` paths, and each of those files carries a `DECISION: <id>` marker at the policy it enforces. bin/check_decision_drift.py checks the two against each other in both directions. Generalised from instrument_rights.json + instrument-rights-gate.mjs, which is this same pattern scoped to one policy. Adding a decision here does NOT create a gate; it creates a claim the drift checker can test.

decisions.title: The SP learner passcode rotates each rotation block
SP_STUDENT_PASSCODE is fixed and does not rotate; a leak needs an explicit same-day change
decisions.note: Rotation WAS the revocation path. Rollback in docs/RED_TEAM_RUNBOOK.md is now the only containment. Never re-add 'rotate the learner passcode' to a checklist.

decisions.title: The no-reproduction rule covers copyrighted instruments only (Option A, #391)
decisions.note: Settles scope, not individual cases. An instrument is exempt only once its status is recorded in instrument_rights.json. If a work package asks for verbatim item or anchor text, stop and ask.

decisions.title: A withdrawal must leave a route — every removed or link-only instrument ships the custodian's official form URL (INV-IR2)
Crisis contacts live in crisis_resources.json only; a page opts in with a marker and the build injects
decisions.note: Scope rule for adding a surface: the learner must plausibly be DOING risk work there — assessing, rehearsing, or planning disposition — not merely reading a page that mentions suicide.

decisions.title: localStorage keys must be namespaced cw_* (shared hub) or rp_* (resident)
decisions.note: Item-id collisions silently corrupt attestation (cw_qbank_attest_v1) and SRS state.

decisions.title: COWS' 45 verbatim anchors stay published under a recorded interim waiver pending the Taylor & Francis letter
decisions.note: This waiver is the one thing still blocking Wave 4. An agent must not narrow or lift it.

decisions.title: The week-page pairing block ships collapsed, not expanded
One derived listing is the only source for “what ships”
decisions.note: site_build/shipped_pages.json is generated from every producer and verified against the real build output on every build. New code reads it; it does not read site_manifest.json or cotw_registry.json. tests/shipped-pages-readers.test.mjs freezes the remaining direct readers, and that list may only shrink.

decisions.title: Analytics event keys come from a generated allowlist
decisions.note: Cohorts are 4-10 learners, so aggregate data can still identify. Free text in an event key is the path by which PHI or a re-identifying detail would reach the counter store. Deriving the allowlist from shipped_pages.json makes what can be measured and what ships the same set by construction.
